lead: A zero-width match right after a non-empty one is dropped by all four `Core\Regex` iterating members.
body: `replace`, `replaceWith`, `matchAll` and `split` use the `regex` crate's `captures_iter`/`split`, which skip it, PCRE does not: `Core\Regex::replace("ab", "b*", "-")` is `-a-`, PHP says `-a--`. Only an oracle sees it, so a differential row must not put a zero-width match after a wide one.
